rows.note: Use 批評 as the all-purpose choice for expressing disapproval or criticism without necessarily scolding someone personally.

example.english: Many residents reprove the new arrangement for being inconvenient.
example.traditional: 好多市民批評呢個新安排唔方便。
example.jyutping: hou2 do1 si5 man4 pai1 ping4 ni1 go3 san1 on1 paai4 m4 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use 責備 when directly telling someone that they have done wrong, especially in a personal or moral reprimand that may still be gentle.

example.english: I’m not trying to reprove you; I just want you to be more careful next time.
example.traditional: 我唔係想責備你，只係想你下次小心啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 soeng2 zaak3 bei6 nei5 zi2 hai6 soeng2 nei5 haa6 ci3 siu2 sam1 di1
